COMMON_FISHBONE.name: Fish Bone
COMMON_FISHBONE.desc: A strange skull-shaped fish bone. Still smells like the deep sea.

COMMON_TRASHBAG.desc: A full trash bag that somehow feels almost… friendly.

COMMON_SHOE.name: Worn Shoe
COMMON_SHOE.desc: Beat-up sneakers that have walked more miles than you'll ever know.

COMMON_APPLECORE.desc: Just an apple core with a few seeds left.

COMMON_BOX.name: Soggy Box
COMMON_BOX.desc: A damp, sagging cardboard box that once held something useful.

RARE_KOHAKU.name: Kohaku
RARE_KOHAKU.desc: White body with red patterns. Classic and elegant.

RARE_TANCHO.name: Tancho
RARE_TANCHO.desc: Pure white with a single red crown on the head.

RARE_ORANJI.name: Oranji Kohaku
RARE_ORANJI.desc: White body with bright orange patterns.

RARE_SHIRO.name: Shiro Bekko

LEGENDARY_GALAXY.desc: Scales align with the trajectories of the stars, reflecting a vastness that commands awe.
